input.subject: Wing B elevator pit - rock removal pricing
input.body: Priya, rock removal pricing for the Wing B elevator pit will come Friday. Hoe-ram and haul-off; our crew is idle on the east half until we hear from Tandem on RFI 41. - Bill

facts.item: RFI 41 response, east half crew idle
